It restores a small number of hearts and has a cooling effect.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Frozen Bird Drumsticks are a type of [[Frozen Food]], being the result of [[Raw Bird Drumstick]]s that have been exposed to [[Freezing Climate]]s or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They are hard to eat, but they restore one [[Heart]] and grant [[Link]] [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Frozen Bird Drumsticks reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. [[Link]] can make them by allowing a [[Raw Bird Drumstick]]s to come into contact with a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. Eating a Frozen Bird Drumstick restore will restore one of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s and allow him one minute of [[Heat Resistance]], although they are known to be difficult to eat. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Bird Thigh * Frozen Food * Frozen Whole Bird * Raw Bird Drumstick * Roasted Bird Drumstick }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Meats |items= BotW, TotK }}
